target_customer: Indian homeowners and contractors buying floor and wall materials (tiles, laminates, wall panels)
problem: Home decor materials go through layered traditional distribution, so prices are high and design choice is slow to refresh.
business_model: online direct-from-manufacturer ecommerce marketplace plus offline experience centres

founders.name: Manish Reddy
prior_employers: Boston Consulting Group (3.5 years, India and USA)

technical_complexity.rationale: Ecommerce plus supply chain and logistics; operations harder than software.

defensibility.rationale: Manufacturer relationships and small-batch design launches may help; Inc42 reports 300,000+ SKUs, but copying a catalogue marketplace is feasible.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found; no shutdown reported as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: YC page says it has served over 10,000 homes (company claim). Reported revenue Rs 13.7 Cr in FY24, up 89.5% from Rs 7.2 Cr in FY23 (Inc42 profile), which shows demand grew after founding.

branding.domain_note: Site materialdepot.in redirects (301) to materialdepot.com; acquisition date unknown.

brand_strength.rationale: No source on brand strength found; not rated.

outcome_analysis: Material Depot (Winter 2022, Active) grew into a team of about 50 with revenue of Rs 7.2 Cr in FY23 and Rs 13.7 Cr in FY24, then raised a 10M USD Series A co-led by Accel and Stellaris in February 2026, about four years after YC. It combined a digital catalogue with offline experience centres in Bengaluru; the main caveat is that profitability is unknown and earlier rounds are only partly documented.
notes: Series A confirmed by Entrackr, Entrepreneur India (dated 2026-02-05), YourStory and Inc42. Earlier funding not itemised: Entrackr says over $4M earlier from YC and others; Inc42 says nearly $14.5M total; Venture Intelligence says about $1M from Whiteboard Capital and Accel India between 2021-10 and 2024-12; a Seedtable URL implies a 2022-03 seed but no amount. Hence coverage partial. Founding year 2021 vs 2022 differs by source. No dated near-batch competitor sources found (search returned only 2021 D2C home decor funding news for unrelated players), so the list is empty.
